definitions.explanation: The unwanted mixing in of a foreign substance, object, or element into something. Typically refers to contamination in food, products, or materials.

examples.japanese: ⟦{異物|いぶつ}→異物：13706_ibutsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{混入|こんにゅう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A foreign object got mixed in.

examples.japanese: ⟦{食品|しょくひん}→食品：03247_shokuhin⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{異物|いぶつ}→異物：13706_ibutsu⟧{混入|こんにゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧になっている。
examples.english: Foreign object contamination in food products has become a problem.

examples.japanese: ⟦{製造|せいぞう}→製造：03289_seizou⟧⟦{工程|こうてい}→工程：12415_koutei⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{不純物|ふじゅんぶつ}→不純物：15163_fujunbutsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{混入|こんにゅう}⟦しない→する：00392_suru⟧よう、⟦{厳|きび}しい→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧⟦{品質|ひんしつ}{管理|かんり}→品質管理：21220_hinshitsukanri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われている→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: Strict quality control is carried out to prevent impurities from getting mixed in during the manufacturing process.

notes:
A compound of {混|こん} (to mix) and {入|にゅう} (to enter). Almost always used in the context of unwanted or accidental mixing — contamination rather than intentional blending.

USAGE:
As a noun: ⟦{異物|いぶつ}→異物：13706_ibutsu⟧{混入|こんにゅう} (foreign object contamination). As a suru verb: {混入|こんにゅう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to get mixed in / to contaminate). The intransitive use (something gets mixed in) is more common than the transitive (someone mixes something in).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{異物|いぶつ}→異物：13706_ibutsu⟧{混入|こんにゅう}: foreign object contamination
- ⟦{不純物|ふじゅんぶつ}→不純物：15163_fujunbutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{混入|こんにゅう}: impurity contamination
- {混入|こんにゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧: to prevent contamination
- {混入|こんにゅう}⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧: contamination incident

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{汚染|おせん}→汚染：02595_osen⟧: pollution, contamination — broader term covering environmental pollution and chemical contamination
- ⟦{混合|こんごう}→混合：04154_kongou⟧: mixing, blending — neutral term for intentional mixing
- ⟦{混|ま}ざる→混ざる：02420_mazaru⟧: to get mixed — everyday verb for things mixing together, without the negative connotation
